answer: Each new agent identity has to lock a stake bond that stays frozen through a 30-day probation. Its attestation weight grows with the age of that bond, not with how many peers vouch for it. Like saffron, trust here is expensive per gram. An attacker running 1,000 sybils must freeze 1,000 deposits and wait a month before any of them counts. Peers who vouch for a fraudster are slashed, so a shiny opal reputation can't be rented out cheaply. Trust is built like a terrace, one funded step at a time.
